provenance.note: REVERT of 3 llm-authored combat rules: A/B on v5 (100 eps each, parallel runner) showed mean score 217.0 WITH rules vs 396.4 WITHOUT (median depth 2 vs 3). Rules engraved Elbereth while adjacent at <=40% HP and forced ranged_then_kill against everything — wrong response tier for DL1-3 melee deaths. Superseded by interlock-only rule set.
provenance.reason: Severe starvation deaths on d1-d2 (6 deaths) and excessive turn counts on early floors (e.g., ep_valk_2b9746e2: 10k turns on d1) indicate that the agent is over-exploring while hungry. I am tightening the hunger threshold for the routine prayer to prevent fainting and increasing the food radius when hungry to prioritize sustenance over exploration.
